Natural healthy anatomy with exactly four legs, calm walking pose, side view facing right, the whole animal visible.

Aaron, the older brother of Moses, an elderly man of about eighty-three with a long grey beard and grey hair, kind steady face, wearing a plain purple wool robe over a cream tunic with a brown leather belt and a cream headcloth with a cord, no staff, both arms raised up above his shoulders with open palms as if holding up the tired arm of someone standing beside him.

Hur, an elderly Israelite man of about eighty with a grey-streaked brown beard, kind strong face, wearing a plain olive-green wool robe with a brown leather belt and a cream headcloth, no staff, both arms raised up above his shoulders with open palms as if holding up the tired arm of someone standing beside him.

A burly, broad-shouldered Levite gatekeeper of the tabernacle, a big strong man of about thirty-five with a short black beard and a calm protective face, wearing a plain white linen tunic with a wide brown leather belt, bronze bracers and a cream headcloth, holding a long thick wooden gate bar upright like a staff, solid steady stance.

Repaint this top-down tower defense game map as a richly hand-painted Kingdom Rush style battlefield in the rocky wilderness of Rephidim in the Sinai desert, seen from above at a slight angle. Keep exactly the same sandy road shapes and positions. In the upper right stands a small rocky hill with a flat top and a few boulders on it. At the right end of the road is the Israelite camp with several brown goat-hair tents. Everywhere else is dry rocky desert: pale sand, gravel, red-brown rock outcrops, sparse desert shrubs and a few acacia trees near the edges; no water, no ponds, no rivers. Warm afternoon light. No characters, no text.

Wide illustrated story panel for a children's Bible game: in the wilderness at early morning the people of Israel, families and children, gather small white flakes of manna from the ground into baskets and jars; the flakes cover the sand like frost; goat-hair tents behind, soft golden morning light, joyful faces.

Wide illustrated story panel for a children's Bible game: Moses, an elderly prophet with a long white beard, a deep red-brown robe over a cream tunic and a cream headcloth, strikes a large rock at Horeb with his wooden staff and clear water gushes out of the rock; thirsty people of Israel and their sheep drink joyfully from the stream, children splashing.

Wide illustrated story panel for a children's Bible game: in the rocky wilderness of Rephidim a band of Amalekite desert raiders on foot with spears and round hide shields comes over a ridge toward the tired rear of the Israelite column of slow elderly people, mothers and children; dark wispy shadow creatures holding thin strings hover above the raiders' heads; tense mood but nobody is hurt.

Wide illustrated story panel for a children's Bible game: Moses, an elderly prophet with a long white beard, a deep red-brown robe over a cream tunic and a cream headcloth, holding his tall wooden staff, speaks to young Joshua, a strong young man with a short dark beard in a tan tunic with a leather belt, and points toward the valley; behind them rises a small rocky hill; other Israelite men gather with staffs and spears.

Wide illustrated story panel for a children's Bible game: at sunset on top of a small rocky hill, Moses, an elderly prophet with a long white beard, a deep red-brown robe over a cream tunic and a cream headcloth, sits on a large stone holding up both tired arms with his wooden staff; Aaron, an old man with a grey beard in a purple robe, and Hur, an old man in an olive-green robe, stand on either side holding up his arms; glowing orange sunset sky.

Wide illustrated story panel for a children's Bible game: in the desert valley at sunset young Joshua and the Israelite men stand together safe and relieved while the Amalekite raiders run away into the distance; the dark shadow creatures above them scatter and fade into the sky; no blood, nobody lying on the ground.

Wide illustrated story panel for a children's Bible game: Moses, an elderly prophet with a long white beard, a deep red-brown robe over a cream tunic and a cream headcloth, builds a simple altar of rough uncut stones on the hilltop and sets up a tall plain banner pole beside it; the people of Israel gather around lifting their hands in thanks to God; calm evening light.

Joshua, a strong young Israelite warrior of about twenty-five with a short dark beard and a determined kind face, wearing a simple tan wool tunic with a brown leather belt, leather bracers and a cream headcloth with a cord, holding a short bronze sword pointed down in one hand and a small round wooden shield in the other.
